40 KNOTS. SEE REF A (WTPN31 PGTW 260300) FOR FURTHER DETAILS.

      (1) THE AREA OF CONVECTION (INVEST 97W) PREVIOUSLY LOCATED NEAR

1.A. FOR DETAILS.
